Arithmetic mean of available hourly snapshots per UTC day. Today is a partial-day average. Dates label calendar days at 00:00:00Z; start and end include their full UTC calendar days. Missing days are omitted. Cached until the next hourly cache boundary.

get.description: Reads producer-calculated wallet shares and Others. Returns null with awaiting_summary while unavailable; V1 remains unchanged. Numeric values are strings.

Current state from Contracts_Active, with top eight counterparties plus Others, exact decimal-string metrics, exclusive end windows, and paginated contracts. BlockTime is a reference, not a certified contract snapshot. Null amounts remain unknown. Both contract versions are included. GET only; successful responses cached for 60 seconds. Database failures return 503, never empty success. See docs/active-contracts.md.

parameters.name: address
parameters.description: Renter wallet. Supply exactly one of address and host_public_key.

parameters.name: host_public_key
parameters.description: Host key; bare and prefixed encodings are both matched.

parameters.name: search
parameters.description: Exact contract ID; lists only, summaries retain the full profile.

200.description: Contract data. Money is Hastings; bytes, heights, and monetary values are strings.

get.summary: Browse completed host or renter contracts
get.description: Returns up to 25 unique resolved contracts with cursor pagination. Multiple revisions are deduplicated. Newest or oldest order; exact contract-ID search remains scoped to the selected host or wallet. Pass pagination.next_after as after to continue with the same sort/search. Successful responses cache for 60 seconds. Errors return 400/405/503. See docs/active-contracts.md. Supply exactly one of host_public_key and address.

parameters.name: address
parameters.description: Canonical renter wallet address. Mutually exclusive with host_public_key.

parameters.name: after
parameters.description: Opaque continuation cursor from data.pagination.next_after. Omit for the first page.

200.description: Contract data. Money is Hastings; bytes, heights, and monetary values are strings.

get.summary: Export settled V2 contract revenue and principal losses
get.description: Public read-only export. Uses authoritative resolution rows and actual maturity timestamps at resolution_height + 144. Money is returned as decimal strings. Loss amounts include only host collateral, excluding unreceived revenue. Incomplete rates make fiat values and summary totals null. Rate means are rounded half up to 24 fractional digits.

parameters.name: host_public_key
parameters.description: Host public key; matches both stored encodings.

parameters.name: from
parameters.description: Inclusive UTC settlement date; dates before 2025-07-01 return 400.

parameters.name: to
parameters.description: Inclusive UTC settlement date; defaults to yesterday UTC.

parameters.name: format
parameters.description: CSV streams one row per contract; JSON includes summary.

parameters.name: currency
parameters.description: Case-insensitive reporting currency. Fiat field suffixes follow the selected currency.

revenue_locked_sc.description: Nonnegative revenue_locked from the authoritative resolution row, in SC with 24 decimal places.

collateral_lost_sc.description: For expirations, max(host_balance - missed_host_output, 0) / 1e24. Only host collateral is included; zero for proofs and renewals.

average_sc_price_eur.description: Null unless the past UTC day has 24 valid observations in 24 distinct hours. Suffix changes with currency.

summary.description: Counts by outcome, unlocked-revenue and collateral-loss SC/fiat totals, incomplete-rate count, requested period, currency, rate method, chain height and generation timestamp.

text/csv.description: Same nine fields as JSON items, with a header row and null prices as empty cells.

400.description: Invalid date, date before 2025-07-01, host key, format or currency.

503.description: Database unavailable or required contract data invalid.
